Well, hello, everyone. Thank you for
taking such good care of my siblings,
mo.

rows.label: qst500112_msg0002
rows.name:
Thanks to you, all eleven of my
siblings made it back safely, mo!

rows.label: qst500112_msg0003
rows.name:
And now the Twelve Nopon Siblings
have three new menu items! Three of
them, mo!

rows.label: qst500112_msg0004
rows.name:
As thanks, I'll give you one of each,
mo!

rows.label: qst500112_msg0005
rows.name: If you like them, please buy more, mo!

rows.label: qst500112_msg0006
rows.name:
Welcome, mo! I came up with a new
menu item, mo.

rows.label: qst500112_msg0007
rows.name:
Thanks for your business, mo!
Please stop by again, mo.

rows.label: qst500112_msg0008
rows.name:
Next time, buy something too, mo.
I'll always be waiting, mooo!

rows.label: qst500112_msg0009
rows.name:
I don't think I should be
shopping around right now...
